items.title: 6.1 Definition and Overview of Emerging Technologies (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Yeh chapter hamare daur ki do sab se inqilabi technologies, cloud computing aur blockchain, dekhta hai: cloud ke bunyadi khayalat aur service aur deployment models, blockchain ke usool, ajza aur istemal, aur edge computing, serverless architectures aur Blockchain 2.0 jaise mustaqbil ke rujhanat.

blocks.title: Emerging technologies
blocks.text: Emerging technologies naye auzaar, nizam aur tareeqe hain jo ban rahe hain ya abhi istemal hone lage hain, aur hamare jeene, kaam karne aur duniya se taamul ke andaaz badalne ki salahiyat rakhte hain.

blocks.caption: Aham emerging technologies
rows: insaan ki tarah seekhne aur faisla karne wali machines
chehra pehchanna, Siri, khud chalne wali gariyan
internet par data aur apps rakhna aur chalana
mushtarak record jise badalna bohat mushkil
asal duniya par digital teh; mukammal virtual duniya
kahin tez aur qabil-e-aitbaar wireless rabta
phones, smart devices, AR aur VR
bohat mushkil masail ke liye quantum physics

blocks.prompt: AR VR se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: AR asal duniya mein digital ajza jorta hai (phone ya ainak se); VR asal duniya ki jagah mukammal virtual mahol bana deta hai.

items: Emerging technologies: AI, cloud, blockchain, IoT, AR/VR, 5G, quantum computing, biotechnology; yeh chapter cloud aur blockchain par markooz hai.
